passages.title: Apartment Building Handbook
passages.intro: Important rules for residents and visitors
paras: Rent must be paid on the first calendar day of every month. Residents should submit non-urgent maintenance requests through the online portal.
A serious water leak must be reported immediately by telephone. Quiet hours run from 10 p.m. until 7 a.m.
Residents must reserve the service lift at least two days before moving. Recycling bins are collected every Thursday morning.
All pets must be registered with the building manager. Visitor parking is limited to a maximum of four hours.
